observedFailure: After script compilation, the bridge could not replace its per-Editor discovery file. Editor.log reported Failed to write Editor lockfile; subsequent CLI requests returned UNAUTHORIZED.
recovery: Archived only this Editor PID's stale discovery file in the local discovery directory, then invoked Tools/Unity CLI/Restart Bridge in the verified FishingCasualGame Unity window.
scope: No package code, authentication setting or Windows permission change.
